meta.title: Dexetera — Trade Any Metric
meta.subtitle: The permissionless protocol for creating and trading futures markets on any measurable metric
meta.purpose: Source-of-truth content for an AI pitch-deck generator. Each object in `slides` maps to one slide. Use `company`, `problem`, `solution`, etc. as supporting context and talking points.

design_direction.typography: clean geometric sans-serif, generous whitespace, large numbers for key stats
design_direction.imagery: abstract data/orderbook visualizations, glowing cyan gradients, no stock photos

company.name: Dexetera
company.tagline: If it can be measured, it can be traded.
company.one_liner: Dexetera is a decentralized protocol that lets anyone create and trade futures markets on any measurable metric — settled trustlessly by an on-chain oracle, with no gatekeepers.
company.stage: Live on mainnet with multiple active markets; building viral growth + organic acquisition engine
company.mission: Remove every gatekeeper between a person and a market they want to trade.
company.vision: A world where any objectively measurable value — inflation, lithium, protocol TVL, a temperature index — has a liquid, permissionless market attached to it.
company.elevator_pitch: Creating a new futures contract today requires regulatory approval, exchange partnerships, and capital. Trading is gated by geography and wealth. Settlement depends on intermediaries who can be slow or compromised. Dexetera inverts this: anyone can deploy a market on any measurable metric in minutes, anyone can trade it with a wallet, and settlement is verified cryptographically through UMA's Optimistic Oracle. The question stops being 'who will let me trade this?' and becomes 'what do I want to trade?'

problem.headline: Derivatives markets are defined by exclusion.
problem.summary: The traditional and even most DeFi derivatives infrastructure locks out the long tail of things people actually want to price and hedge.

pain_points.title: Permission is the prerequisite
pain_points.detail: Launching a new futures contract requires regulatory approval, exchange partnerships, and significant capital. The vast majority of measurable metrics never get a market.

pain_points.title: Trading is gatekept
pain_points.detail: Access is restricted by geography, wealth thresholds, and institutional gatekeeping. Most of the world cannot participate.

pain_points.title: Settlement requires trust
pain_points.detail: Outcomes depend on centralized intermediaries who can be slow, opaque, or compromised.

pain_points.title: DeFi only solved crypto
pain_points.detail: Perp DEXs brought derivatives on-chain but only for crypto assets, using AMMs and mark-price settlement. Prediction markets handle events but not continuous metrics, and creation is still limited.

problem.stakes: Trillions of dollars of real-world risk — commodities, macro data, protocol metrics, climate, sports — has no permissionless, on-chain way to be priced, hedged, or speculated on.

solution.headline: Dexetera: permissionless futures on any measurable metric.
solution.summary: Combine a true on-chain orderbook with UMA's Optimistic Oracle for trustless settlement. Anyone creates a market, anyone trades, no one controls the outcome.

pillars.title: Permissionless creation
pillars.detail: Deploy a market on any metric through a Market Creation Wizard — define the metric, the data source, the settlement date, and parameters. No approval needed.

pillars.title: True on-chain orderbook
pillars.detail: Real bid/ask price discovery with limit and market orders, not bonding-curve AMMs. Capital-efficient, transparent, and familiar to traders.

pillars.title: Trustless settlement
pillars.detail: UMA's Optimistic Oracle V3 settles markets. Proposers post evidence and a bond; anyone can dispute; disputes escalate to UMA's DVM vote. No central settlement authority.

pillars.title: Non-custodial by design
pillars.detail: Funds stay in user wallets until used for trading; collateral sits in the CoreVault contract, never with a central party.

before_after.before: Markets are scarce, gated, and centrally settled.
before_after.after: Markets are abundant, open, and cryptographically settled.

how_it_works.headline: From metric to liquid market in four steps.

steps.title: Define the metric
steps.detail: A creator specifies what is being measured (e.g. 'Price of Gold in USD'), the public data source, and the settlement date.

steps.title: Deploy the market
steps.detail: A dedicated on-chain market is deployed as its own Diamond contract (EIP-2535) with an isolated orderbook and settlement logic, so issues in one market never affect others.

steps.title: Trade long or short
steps.detail: Traders take leveraged long/short positions collateralized in USDC, using market or limit orders against a live on-chain orderbook with a mark price for P&L and liquidations.

steps.title: Settle trustlessly
steps.detail: At expiry a proposer submits the final value plus verifiable evidence and a bond. A challenge window opens; undisputed values settle automatically, disputed ones escalate to UMA's DVM. Positions close at the oracle-verified price.

use_cases.headline: One protocol, an unbounded market surface.

core_use_case.title: Create a market on anything measurable, then trade it
core_use_case.narrative: A user in Lagos creates a market on Nigerian inflation. A trader in São Paulo takes a position on the price of lithium. A developer in Berlin spins up a market on their protocol's TVL. None of them asked permission. Each market is its own page and its own on-chain contract, tradeable by anyone with a wallet.

use_cases.only_requirement: The metric must be objectively measurable at settlement time from a publicly accessible source.

why_now.headline: The infrastructure finally exists.
drivers: High-throughput, low-cost EVM chains (HyperLiquid) make on-chain orderbooks viable at the speed trading demands.
UMA's Optimistic Oracle has secured billions in value, proving economically-secure trustless settlement at scale.
Perp DEXs have trained millions of users on non-custodial, wallet-based derivatives trading.
Demand for hedging and speculation on real-world metrics (macro, commodities, climate) keeps growing while access stays gated.

product.headline: Professional-grade trading, permissionless plumbing.
trading_features: Long and short leveraged positions collateralized in USDC
Market and limit orders on a real on-chain orderbook
Mark price for live valuation, unrealized P&L, and liquidation thresholds
Oracle-verified settlement price at expiry (not mark price)
interface_features: Per-market shareable pages with dynamic social cards
product.creator_experience: A guided Market Creation Wizard turns a metric definition into a live, isolated, tradeable market contract.

technology.headline: Modular, isolated, upgradeable, trust-minimized.
architecture_highlights: On-chain orderbook (not AMM) for genuine price discovery and capital efficiency
Diamond pattern (EIP-2535): markets are individual Diamond contracts with modular, upgradeable facets (trading, settlement, admin)
Per-market isolation: each market has its own orderbook and settlement storage, so failures don't cascade
FacetRegistry-based upgrades: code upgrades propagate to every market atomically
UMA Optimistic Oracle V3 for evidence-backed, bonded, disputable settlement

smart_contracts.function: Interfaces with UMA Optimistic Oracle V3

technology.blockchain: HyperLiquid — high throughput, low transaction costs, EVM compatibility
technology.frontend: Next.js + React trading interface with TradingView charts and real-time orderbook

settlement_and_security.headline: Trust replaced with cryptography and economic incentives.
settlement_flow: Proposer submits settlement value + evidence URL + bond
If no challenge → settlement executes at proposed value
If challenged → escalates to UMA's Data Verification Mechanism (DVM)
DVM vote determines final value → settlement executes
evidence_requirements: Screenshot of the data source at settlement time
Hash of evidence stored on-chain for permanent verifiability

incentives.proposer_bond: Forfeited if the proposal is successfully challenged
incentives.effect: Skin-in-the-game on both sides discourages frivolous proposals and baseless disputes.

security_principles: Non-custodial: user funds remain in wallets until used for trading
Oracle security: UMA's model makes corruption cost exceed potential profit
Upgrade safety: Diamond/FacetRegistry pattern allows targeted upgrades without migrating funds or positions

business_model.headline: Fees scale with markets and volume.

revenue_streams.detail: A small percentage of notional value on every trade, split between the protocol and the market creator.
A nominal fee to cover oracle costs at settlement.

business_model.creator_incentive: Market creators earn a share of the trading fees their markets generate — aligning incentives so creators build markets that attract real volume.
business_model.flywheel: More creators → more markets → more long-tail demand captured → more volume → more fees shared back to creators → more creators.

growth_strategy.headline: A viral share layer plus a programmatic-SEO acquisition engine.

components: Dynamic per-market social share cards (OG images) that unfurl richly on X, Telegram, and Discord
Referral tracking with unique codes and atomic on-chain-backed attribution
Points system rewarding referrals, first trades, volume milestones, and successful market creation
Public leaderboard to surface and gamify top users

organic_layer.status: Foundation shipped; programmatic pages in progress
organic_layer.thesis: Every market is already its own page (/token/[symbol]). With the right technical SEO foundation, Dexetera auto-publishes a rankable page for every market it lists — at the same rate it creates markets.
components: Dynamic sitemap + robots covering every active market
Server-rendered market facts and JSON-LD structured data per market
Editorial /learn content capturing top-of-funnel informational demand
Directory/aggregator listings (DefiLlama, DappRadar, CoinGecko) for authority and qualified traffic

growth_strategy.funnel: Organic + social discovery → wallet connect → first trade → referral loop and points → leaderboard → repeat.

competition.headline: Neither traditional futures, prediction markets, nor perp DEXs cover this surface.
moats: The only protocol combining permissionless creation + custom metrics + orderbook + trustless oracle settlement + non-custodial
Market-creator fee share builds a supply-side network of market creators competitors lack
Programmatic page-per-market structure compounds an organic acquisition moat over time

traction.headline: Live, with the growth engine coming online.
milestones: Viral share + referral + points systems implemented
Technical SEO foundation shipped; programmatic market-page SEO in progress

roadmap.headline: From live protocol to cross-chain market layer.

market_opportunity.headline: Every measurable metric is a potential market.
market_opportunity.framing: The serviceable surface is not one asset class — it's the union of crypto, commodities, indices, macroeconomics, climate, sports, and social metrics. Dexetera's permissionless model means the addressable market expands every time a creator finds a new metric worth pricing.
talking_points: Global derivatives notional dwarfs the underlying spot markets — and that's only the standardized contracts that exist today.
Dexetera unlocks the long tail of metrics that never qualified for a traditional contract.
Supply (creators) and demand (traders) are both permissionless, so the market count is uncapped.
